rationale.consistency: Follows existing patterns perfectly, correctly utilizes the git package, and integrates seamlessly with CLI conventions.
rationale.edge_cases: Properly validates paths, mutually exclusive flags, checks existing branches before action, and safely scopes pulls via a copied git client.
rationale.scope: Fulfills all requirements directly, extracts the worktree module accurately, and avoids any unrelated refactors.
rationale.readability: The extracted WorktreeTarget and logic into the shared package are extremely clean; command abstractions are clear and well-named.
rationale.robustness: Correctly prevents fast-forwarding non-existent branches, guards against invalid symlinks, and properly isolates git commands per-worktree.
rationale.maintainability: Excellent reuse of worktree path resolution between both issue develop and pr checkout commands, centralizing worktree logic perfectly.
